title: Messy Bedroom Chaos
description: A cluttered and unkempt bedroom with a wooden desk holding a computer monitor displaying blue terminal text. The floor is covered in scattered clothes, papers, books including Hellboy comics, a black office chair with a red tote bag, a black fan, and various personal items.
prompt: A realistic photograph of a very messy and disorganized bedroom with beige walls and wooden floor.
